mode_inference_decision: Source-approved licensed 3D asset, surface-based offline posing and actual viewmodel camera validation. No invented bitmap assets.
scope: Measure original skin/bone landmarks and real rifle surfaces before authoring one rifle grip. Validate contact and the complete supported camera/animation envelope independently of export correctness.
source_policy: Keep licensed source geometry, UVs, full source object frame and original normalized relative weights as the baseline. Corrective geometry/weights require a localized measured deformation defect and their own before/after evidence; no blanket rerig requirement.
contact_policy: Choose anatomical skin patches and explicit rifle mesh/triangle/barycentric targets in the same gun coordinate frame. Palm contact and individual finger pads must be evaluated, including opposing surface normals, clearance and full-hand intersections. Bone tips or unsigned nearest distances alone cannot approve contact. No repeated wrist/forward/curl grid.
camera_policy: A source cut boundary may remain only if proven outside the complete supported camera/animation envelope. Otherwise finish the visible cuff/cut geometry using approved source art. A hidden boundary alone does not require watertight full-body topology. Hip, ADS, recoil, movement, view switch, reload extrema, aspect ratios and clipping must be covered before integration.
deformation_policy: Maintain anatomical proportions, fixed bone lengths and smooth elbow/wrist volume. Preserve the proven shared palm roll transport. Local defects require source comparison, not scalar strain used as a stand-in for visual acceptance.
animation_policy: One continuous dual-arm rig. Never use rigid support_hand translation on a skinned forearm. An arms-only reload clip or equivalent bone animation must be integrated and verified before runtime publication.
material_policy: Original source skin is a diagnostic checkpoint only. Finished tactical glove/sleeve appearance must come from approved licensed/manual/generated sources with provenance, UV and lighting review.
gates: anatomical palm and individual finger surface contact
unchanged proportions and fixed bone lengths
source-to-GLB skin parity and independent clones
supported camera and animation envelope without visible cut boundaries
actual hip ADS firing and continuous reload captures
independent deformation, contact and appearance review
not_completion: A measured surface or correct export is not an accepted pose
A static rifle checkpoint is not the complete weapon set
This contract does not approve V13 or replace runtime assets
